props.name: eventTypes
props.comment: Available event-type strings to surface as checkboxes.

props.name: onTestPing
props.comment: Optional test-ping handler. When set, renders the test-ping button.

props.name: source
props.comment: The field path (dot/bracket), relative to the ambient source scope.

props.name: label
props.comment: Explicit label, or `false` to hide it. Absent → humanized `source`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.comment: Input-level default (seeds only into a hole), typed as the value at `source`.

props.name: validate
props.comment: ra-contract validators — composed, first error wins.
